title: Import state
description: Where an import stopped. A run that is cut off — a usage limit, a job timeout, a rate limit that does not clear — must be resumable without doing the finished part again, and the only place that survives the runner is the repository, so the cursor is committed with each batch. It is not a record and asserts nothing about the world: it is a list of identifiers already dealt with. Written by the tool, never by hand; deleting it starts the walk over, which is safe because every mode is idempotent.

runs.description: One cursor per mode, because --reconcile and --import walk different lists and neither may clobber the other's place.

updated.description: The day the last batch of this mode was written.

pending.description: What is left to do, in order. Empty means the walk finished; the next run seeds it again from the seeds file.

done.description: What this walk has already dealt with, so a resumed run neither refetches it nor rewrites it.
